data.content:
### Troyes

❓ Troyes will be without Anis Ouzenadji and Yacouba Kone, both with knee injuries. Striker Timothe Nkada is a doubt. He scored against Lens and provided an assist against Le Mans

## Predicted Lineups

📋 PSG’s predicted starting XI: Safonov - Zaire-Emery, Zabarnyi, Hernandez, Digne - Joao Neves, Beraldo, Dro Fernandez - Akliouche, Mayulu, Godts.

📋 Troyes’ predicted starting XI: Konate - Maronnier, Monfray, Diaz, Gozzi - Mille, Karim, Diop - Ifnaoui, Ripart, Nkada. [...] ### PSG

❓ PSG will be without Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Ousmane Dembele, Marquinhos and Nuno Mendes. Kvaratskhelia has torn the cruciate ligament in his right knee and will not return before the spring. Dembele and Marquinhos both suffered thigh injuries against Barcelona. Illia Zabarnyi is the most likely replacement for Marquinhos at centre-back. Nuno Mendes has been nursing a left thigh injury since the match in Strasbourg.

### Troyes [...] A lengthy injury list has not stopped PSG from winning. After the match against Barcelona on 20 October, Ousmane Dembélé, Marquinhos and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia were sidelined, while Nuno Mendes had picked up an injury earlier in Strasbourg. Since then, the Parisians have not dropped a point and have scored 11 goals in their last two matches. Others have taken on the goalscoring: right-back Achraf Hakimi scored a hat-trick in Le Havre. PSG lead Ligue 1 with 20 points - two more than Lille.
